title: CS5351 requirements record
description: Schema for docs/req/requirements.yaml. One requirement per record. Identifiers are stable and must not be renamed once approved.

validation_method.description: How this file was actually checked, stated honestly (e.g. YAML parse only vs. jsonschema against req-schema.json).

priority.description: MoSCoW priority. Required for every requirement: a requirement without a priority cannot be scoped or deferred honestly.

fit_criterion.description: The explicit condition in which this requirement is judged to fit the course project: what outcome is acceptable and what outcome is not.

metric.description: What is measured for this requirement, in observable terms (e.g. 'model invocations on invalid input').

threshold.description: The boundary the metric must satisfy (e.g. '0', '<= 2', 'byte-identical'). Must be stated when a metric is stated.

evidence.description: Repository evidence as file:line or explicit hypothesis label.

verification.description: Test IDs from docs/verification/agent-contract-test-spec.md, or 'manual: ' with a reason.

verified_by.description: Repository test node IDs that actually executed and asserted this requirement. Absent or empty means no executed test is claimed.

tradeoff.description: What is given up by satisfying this requirement, or the cost it imposes.

source.description: Where the requirement comes from: an approval record, the ADR section, or a supervisor review finding.
